sloka: अर्दयन् रावणं रामो राघवं चापि रावणः ।गतिवेगं समापन्नौ प्रवर्तननिवर्तने ।। ६.११०.४ ।।
transliteration: ardayan rāvaṇaṁ rāmo rāghavaṁ cāpi rāvaṇaḥ ।gativegaṁ samāpannau pravartananivartane ।। 6.110.4 ।।

translations.english: Ravana hurting Rama and vice versa displaying quickness in retaliation and speed of arrows, the fight happened.
